description: Source code for dynamic quantized linear operations in PyTorch, including implementations for FBGEMM, QNNPACK, oneDNN, and ACL backends, with support for fused ReLU and weight packing.

classes.name: QLinearDynamicInt8
classes.description: Template class for running dynamic quantized linear operations with optional fused ReLU.

classes.name: QLinearDynamicFp16
classes.description: Template class for running dynamic FP16 linear operations with optional fused ReLU.

classes.name: QLinearUnpackedDynamicFp16
classes.description: Class for running unpacked FP16 linear operations, supporting prepacking and meta info.

classes.name: LinearDynamicFp16Onednn
classes.description: Class for FP16 linear operations using oneDNN backend, with support for ReLU fusion.

classes.name: PackedLinearWeightFp16
classes.description: Class for packed FP16 linear weights with methods for applying dynamic operations and setting bias.

classes.name: PackedLinearWeightsQnnp
classes.description: Class for packed weights for QNNPACK backend with methods for applying dynamic operations.

classes.name: PackedLinearWeightsACL
classes.description: Class for packed weights using ACL backend with fallback to oneDNN.

classes.name: PackedLinearWeightsOnednn
classes.description: Class for packed weights using oneDNN backend with methods for dynamic application.

methods.name: apply_dynamic_impl
methods.description: Implementation of dynamic quantized linear operation with optional ReLU fusion for various backends.

methods.name: apply_dynamic
methods.description: Public method to run dynamic quantized linear operation.

methods.name: apply_dynamic_relu
methods.description: Public method to run dynamic quantized linear operation with fused ReLU.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Static method to execute the operation, dispatching based on template parameter for ReLU fusion.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Provides meta information (output shape) for the operation without executing it.

methods.name: set_bias
methods.description: Sets the bias tensor for the packed weight object.
